hvmc 0.0.0-dev is installed in namespace hvmc.

The coordinator runs as Deployment hvmc-coordinator (2 replicas); the
leader carries the label hvmc.fax.fyi/leader=true.

The coordinator applies HostConfig "default" from ConfigMap hvmc-hostconfig
(values.hostConfig).

1. Enrollment endpoint

   https://hvmc.example.com/v1/enroll

2. CA fingerprint (the same for every agent, which pins it):

   kubectl -n hvmc exec deploy/hvmc-coordinator -- hvmc ca export

3. Agents. Run each install command as Administrator (Windows) or root (Linux)
   on the machine named in its heading. Replace <token> with the output of the
   kubectl line (bootstrap tokens are single-use, valid 24 h and re-created
   until the agent has enrolled) and <fingerprint> with the fingerprint from 2.

   == Host agent "host" on hyperv-01.example.com (Windows, elevated PowerShell)
   token: kubectl -n hvmc get secret hvmc-bootstrap-host -o go-template='{{.data.token | base64decode}}'

     Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/matfax/hvmc/releases/download/v0.0.0-dev/hvmc_0.0.0-dev_windows_amd64.zip -OutFile hvmc.zip
     Expand-Archive -Path hvmc.zip -DestinationPath hvmc
     .\hvmc\hvmc.exe agent install --role host --enroll https://hvmc.example.com/v1/enroll --token <token> --ca-sha256 <fingerprint>

   == Guest agent "linux-node-1" on linux-node-1 (Linux, root shell)
   token: kubectl -n hvmc get secret hvmc-bootstrap-linux-node-1 -o go-template='{{.data.token | base64decode}}'

     curl -fsSLO https://github.com/matfax/hvmc/releases/download/v0.0.0-dev/hvmc_0.0.0-dev_linux_amd64.tar.gz
     tar -xzf hvmc_0.0.0-dev_linux_amd64.tar.gz hvmc
     ./hvmc agent install --role guest --enroll https://hvmc.example.com/v1/enroll --token <token> --ca-sha256 <fingerprint>

   == Guest agent "windows-node-1" on windows-node-1 (Windows, elevated PowerShell)
   token: kubectl -n hvmc get secret hvmc-bootstrap-windows-node-1 -o go-template='{{.data.token | base64decode}}'

     Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/matfax/hvmc/releases/download/v0.0.0-dev/hvmc_0.0.0-dev_windows_amd64.zip -OutFile hvmc.zip
     Expand-Archive -Path hvmc.zip -DestinationPath hvmc
     .\hvmc\hvmc.exe agent install --role guest --enroll https://hvmc.example.com/v1/enroll --token <token> --ca-sha256 <fingerprint>

   == Guest agent "docker-host-1" on docker-host-1.example.com (Windows, elevated PowerShell)
   token: kubectl -n hvmc get secret hvmc-bootstrap-docker-host-1 -o go-template='{{.data.token | base64decode}}'

     Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/matfax/hvmc/releases/download/v0.0.0-dev/hvmc_0.0.0-dev_windows_amd64.zip -OutFile hvmc.zip
     Expand-Archive -Path hvmc.zip -DestinationPath hvmc
     .\hvmc\hvmc.exe agent install --role guest --enroll https://hvmc.example.com/v1/enroll --token <token> --ca-sha256 <fingerprint>

   == Guest agent "probe-1" on probe-1.example.com (Windows, elevated PowerShell)
   token: kubectl -n hvmc get secret hvmc-bootstrap-probe-1 -o go-template='{{.data.token | base64decode}}'

     Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/matfax/hvmc/releases/download/v0.0.0-dev/hvmc_0.0.0-dev_windows_amd64.zip -OutFile hvmc.zip
     Expand-Archive -Path hvmc.zip -DestinationPath hvmc
     .\hvmc\hvmc.exe agent install --role guest --enroll https://hvmc.example.com/v1/enroll --token <token> --ca-sha256 <fingerprint>

4. Watch the agents become Ready:

   kubectl get hostconfig default --watch
   kubectl get hostconfig default -o jsonpath='{range .status.agents[*]}{.name}{"\t"}{.state}{"\n"}{end}'
